space: pilot root (Animator object), Unity axes: x right, y up, z forward; quaternions [x, y, z, w]
source: Mixamo Pulling A Rope frames 225-662 (1:1, 30 fps) retargeted onto the rig; arms pitched up 27.8 deg; frame 1 and 438 = the idle sample; he steps into the stance over frames 1-27 (left foot then right, 4 cm arcs) and back over the last 27

steps.note: clip frames each foot is in the air (inclusive): in = idle -> stance, out = stance -> idle (step_back)

stance.facing: the capture's tug stance: the rope runs to his right-front (86 deg from his facing), his feet planted, spread along the rope

princeReference.note: QA renders put the prince 1.2 m at the pilot's left-front 45 deg (spec)

stance.note: the pilot's ground is the well's deck; the well's base (pivot) is 0.119 m under it (well_base_z); its yaw in character space is clockwise from above (Unity). No root motion: the hips sway -0.12..0.11 m along the rope over the planted feet

rope.rope_len: bucket rope from the wheel (rope_wheel, the far side of the groove) straight down to the hook (rope_hook), m: DesertWellRig.SetLength(rope_len); the pulley turns by the change of rope_len / 0.13 rad. The bucket hangs on the hook the whole clip (bucket_on hook): when he lets go the rig holds it (no tie-off)

haul_line.note: no post any more: the haul strand leaves the pulley wheel on his side at post_exit (the tangent point, kept under the old field name) and runs straight down the line to the gripping fist(s): per_frame rope_hands (root space). While a hand re-grabs up the rope the other holds; after rope_release nothing holds the strand: let it hang from post_exit

tie_off.note: the haul strand's tie-off (DesertWellRig): a wooden peg on PostA's -Z face ~1.0 m over the deck (base, axis out of the post, tilted up 10 deg), the rope ~2 turns round it, then down onto the rim and over its edge (drop_profile: radius from the well's axis, well-local height; < 0 = on the deck) to a loose coil at the post's foot (the spare: coil_spare_m at the rest length, paying out as the bucket goes down). Rest and after rope_release (+ settle_s): wheel -> peg taut

tail_anchor.note: Held (grab_lead_frames before the first rope_hands frame .. rope_release): wheel -> leading fist -> rear fist -> on bend_lead_m along the strand -> a slack tail falling to the deck (bowed away_m out to his front, clear of his legs; it leaves along away_m / drop_k * the fist's height), where the hauled rope (start_len - rope_len so far) piles in loose turns round pile_root (his root space, on the deck) -> a run along the deck to the coil at the post's foot. Between grips the last grip holds the shape; at rope_release the rope keeps its shape, then settles onto the peg over tie_off.settle_s; the pile stays. Between grips both hands slide up the strand: it runs on through their points on the line
